mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT order_no AS orderNo, member_no AS memberNo, orderer_name AS ordererName, order_status AS orderStatus, total_price AS totalPrice, created_at AS createdAt FROM orders WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.*, ROWNUM AS rnum FROM ( SELECT order_no AS orderNo, member_no AS memberNo, orderer_name AS ordererName, order_status AS orderStatus, total_price AS totalPrice, created_at AS createdAt, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone_number AS receiverPhoneNumber, receiver_zip_code AS receiverZipCode, receiver_base_address AS receiverBaseAddress, receiver_detail_address AS receiverDetailAddress, message FROM orders WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC ) a WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum > #{startRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
